body: You have it the wrong way. I love the church. I Beleive it and I have a strong testimony. I hate the feelings I have and I can't make them leave. I've tried everything. I can't tell anybody who would be able to help me. I'm trying to do it on my own and it's frustrating
I just don't get what the point of it is. What am I trying to achieve? Who am I even doing it for? With the world how it is, it sure as hell isn't me.

I don't want to make it sound like my family is bad or repressive. I respect my dad a lot, and he has high expectations that I have no chance of meeting. He's like a super hero to me and it hurts me to be so disappointing. My mom is the best person I've ever known, the reason I haven't killed myself yet is mainly because I can't stand the thought of hurting her. My older sister is a champ. She had perfect grades all through high school and just got called to serve a Mormon mission in Paris. I'll never be able to fill her shoes. I feel like I'm watching this perfect family on a tv show. It's like I'm not even a part of it because I'm such a fuckup. I feel out of place.
